spans.s:
कोजागर को-जागर, अस्, m. a kind of festi-
val, the night of full moon in the month Āśvina
(September — October), celebrated with various games;
(according to some authorities from कः and जागर,
‘who is awake?’ the exclamation of Lakṣmī, who
descending on this night, promised wealth to all that
were awake; hence the night is spent in festivity and
games of chance in honour of the goddess.)
